title: How to get output of different styles with different sizes same in clo3d.
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/b11a9f7978d44517bcbf7bba85bde782/images/f4d8b9d8aa3e455980e627fbd8bba55cScreenshot%202025-09-08%20151546.jpg)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/b11a9f7978d44517bcbf7bba85bde782/images/ef68796cae19418e829a1aaa1818d784Down%20hoodie_0.gif)I need help regarding 360 turntable rendering in Clo3D. I design multiple garments of different sizes (short and long), but in 360 turntable rendering I want to keep all of their sizes the same. I have tried everything, every setting is the same for every style, but still the longer jacket appears big and the short jacket appears small.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Make sure when recording the video/animation in CLO that the garments are placed on the same location. If you have hidden avatars make sure they are both standing at 000 (center of the 3D space) and are the same height.For the Camera Check the focal distance, Camera Field of View. and then for a turntable you are always starting at the same point (best to create a Custom view and use that for both projects).Or you can instead make a camera rotation and use the Animation mode to do this. It is a more advanced option, but will give you more control.Also keep in mind these are two very different garments. One is larger and oversized and the other is more tight fitting. So the Tight fitting one will naturally be smaller than the oversized one
content_description: This page provides guidance on achieving consistent garment sizing in 360 turntable renderings within Clo3D, ensuring all designs appear uniformly scaled regardless of their actual dimensions.

title: [Feedback] Flat Patterns? Try It Out & Get a Coupon!
content:
Hello everyone!  
This is the CONNECT Team👋

* * *

Did you notice something new on our main page?

![4a7c92999b794a9191722c30dcb22e30](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/fa0b2917deaf4659b57c9aac812a77e9/images/4a7c92999b794a9191722c30dcb22e30image.png)  
That’s right! We’ve temporarily added a new section called **Flat Patterns** , just below _Curator’s Pick_.

## _👉 So, what are_** _Flat Patterns_** _?_

  
We’ve been curious to see if there’s demand for pattern files in their **_unsewn_** format. That’s why we decided to run a small test together with pattern creator [Minerva](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/548179/collection/collections).

✨You can download the files from the link below, try them out, and then leave your thoughts and feedback in the comments.  
💌As a token of appreciation, we’ll be giving out **CONNECT coupons** to those who provide helpful feedback.

If this test shows that there’s strong interest in pattern files, we’ll also consider adding a dedicated **Flat Patterns category** in the future.

Your honest feedback helps us make **CONNECT** even better.  
**We’d love to hear from you, and thank you for joining this test!** 🩵**🙏**

# [[Free Download Link]](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/548179/collection/collections/2508DDfa5bc57c2d8e406f878eaad50b974476)

Thank you.

The CONNECT Team
